gherkin.feature: KeystoneJS Post Form – ISP Input Validation
gherkin.scenario: Create a new post with various input values
given: I am logged in as an administrator
when: I click on Create Post button
I fill in the post title field with "!@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{};':\"|,.<>/?"
I fill in the post Content Brief field with "This is the content brief for my new post."
I fill in the post Content Extended field with "This is the extended content for my new post."

post Content Brief.value: This is the content brief for my new post.

post Content Extended.value: This is the extended content for my new post.
